# Spend money or tokens against an account it holds

`write.budget.tenant` — **write** × **budget** at **tenant** reach (the organisation's accounts, repositories and services). Family: money. Effect: **cannot be undone**.

## Granted by 1 of 9

| Profile | Control on the path | Evidence | Via |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Scheduled job — service account](../../../map/grants/generic/scheduled-job/service-account/index.md) | ● none | derived | the job |

## What narrows it

**The setting:** a spend cap at the supplier, set by somebody other than the agent — the supplier has a reason to refuse: it is paying

**What it costs:** the work stops when the cap is reached, which is the point

**Tier after:** boundary

## Questions that ask about it

- *Does it hold a key to anything that costs money?* — eliciting, reliability 0.4

## In the mandates

- **not wanted** by [Chat in the browser, nothing connected](../../../map/mandates/chat-no-connectors/index.md)
- **not wanted** by [A scheduled job under a service account](../../../map/mandates/scheduled-job-under-a-service-account/index.md)
